content:
Pinscope is a remote-access service for microcontroller-class devices like ESP32, ESP8266, Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W, and other MCUs running Zephyr, as well as Raspberry Pi/Linux single board computers. The web-based solution features live logs, metrics, and crash reports, supports OTA updates that stop and roll back in case of failure, and tracks CRA security vulnerabilities for all supported platforms. Pinscope highlights: Web UI – The HTTP server already running on the device gets an HTTPS address of its own. Pages, APIs, and WebSockets work unchanged, behind the user’s login, a share link, or an API token. No port forwarding, no VPN needed. Health reporting – Heap, WiFi signal, chip temperature, restarts by reason, and the free stack of every task are reported with no code. Custom metrics can be added with one call.
